pages.caption: Packed. Ready. Ace, Riff, and Scorch don't leave camp a mess.
Then the jungle starts screaming. Something huge is crushing homes. Nobody can even see its face.
They take off after it. Gear hits the dirt. The plan falls apart.
They try to get it together. Hard to fight when your stuff is everywhere.
Ace holds the line. Riff and Scorch are with him. The monster is right there.
Then the jungle splits them. Vines. Panic. Ace is on his own.
Ace keeps his shots clean. One ball. Right down the throat.
Monster's out. Gear's packed. That's how you win.
